#!/bin/bash set -o pipefail
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv Managed_Inputs.csv unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
conn_user='postgres' conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-8086eb77-cd6d-48bc-9298-4380892798ca' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ -z $conn_pass ]] then echo "Secretsmanager call failed" exit 255 else echo "Secretsmanager call succeeded" fi database_psql_host_address='dictionarydb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com' DB="dccharmonized"
echo "testing connection to db" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet \ --host="$database_psql_host_address" \ --port="5432" \ --username="$conn_user" \ --dbname="$DB" \ -c "\q" # This command tests the connection and exits
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Connection test failed!" exit 255 else echo "Connection test succeeded - conn_user=$conn_user database_psql_host_address=$database_psql_host_address DB=$DB" fi
echo "fetching applicable table list for dcc" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "\COPY (SELECT table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'decoded' order by table_name) to dataset_list.csv WITH (FORMAT CSV)"
mkdir output mkdir output/completed
IFS=',' while read dataset; do
echo "getting $dataset" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "\COPY (select hpds_id, concept_path, nval, tval, '0' as start_date from decoded.$dataset left join hpds_mappings.merged_mappings on dbgap_subject_id = dbgap_id and source_study_accession = merged_mappings.phs where hpds_id is not null and ( tval is not null or nval is not null ) order by concept_path, hpds_id) to output/HRMN_allConcepts_$dataset.csv with (FORMAT CSV, HEADER FALSE, FORCE_QUOTE *)" cat output/HRMN_allConcepts_$dataset.csv >> output/completed/HRMN_allConcepts.csv done < dataset_list.csv
PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user --csv -Atc \ "select json_agg(meta) from (select dataset_ref, name, display, concept_type, concept_path, JSON_BUILD_OBJECT('description', description) as metadata from dict.metadata) meta" -o output/completed/hrmn_metadata.json
export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/root/bin:/root/bin aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` rm -f assume-role-output.txt
aws s3 cp output/completed/HRMN_allConcepts.csv s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/hrmn/completed/ --quiet aws s3 cp output/completed/hrmn_metadata.json s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/hrmn/decoded_data/ --quiet aws s3 cp output/completed/hrmn_metadata.json s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/DCC_Harmonized_data_set/metadata/hrmn_metadata.json --quiet
